info.title: OctoEvidence.Cli
info.description: File-backed knowledge and traceability control plane for a four-role delivery team: cited facts, needs to requirements, stories to platform tasks, briefs, proven changes, and feature documents, operated by agents and reviewed by humans through the CLI, MCP, or a loopback web portal.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Four-role delivery knowledge: register cited facts, trace them into records, stories, and tasks, and generate reviews and feature documents.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Detect the repository and create or repair only its configuration and knowledge manifest.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --knowledge-root
options.description: Knowledge directory for a new setup, relative to the repository or absolute; defaults to knowledge-base.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Optional repository platform override; repeat for cross-platform repositories.

options.name: --source
options.description: Optional developer source-code glob override; repeat for multiple source/test roots.

options.name: --role
options.description: Lifecycle role or friendly alias used to tailor setup and the starter prompt. [default: lifecycle-coordinator]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report detection and planned writes without changing any file. [default: False]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Validate repository configuration, canonical knowledge, and every declared project.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Install the agent operating contract and create role-specific lifecycle prompts.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Install lifecycle guidance, one selected specialist agent, and managed project instructions.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace modified OctoEvidence-owned skill and specialist-agent assets. [default: False]

options.name: --role
options.description: Lifecycle role or friendly alias; installs only that specialist agent. [default: lifecycle-coordinator]

options.name: --prune
options.description: Remove exact matching built-in agent assets outside the selected role and target. [default: False]

options.name: --target
options.description: Agent host assets to install: all, codex, or claude. [default: all]

commands.name: roles
commands.description: List closed agent roles, the stages and knowledge collections each one writes, and required handoffs.

options.name: --explain
options.description: Show one role in full: stages, knowledge collections it writes, preconditions, and its ready prompt.

commands.name: prompt
commands.description: Create a ready-to-use prompt for one lifecycle role, operating mode, and requested task.

options.name: --role
options.description: Agent role from `octoevidence agent roles`. [default: lifecycle-coordinator]

options.name: --mode
options.description: delivery or knowledge. `knowledge` forbids repository edits, review, change advance, and project mutation. [default: delivery]

options.name: --task
options.description: The concrete work this session must do; included verbatim in the prompt.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Existing lcy_<UUIDv7> the session must operate inside rather than create.

commands.name: id
commands.description: Generate immutable time-ordered UUIDv7 identities; aliases and paths stay mutable metadata.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Generate one or more typed lifecycle identities.

options.name: --count

arguments.name: KIND

commands.name: knowledge

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Install local JSON schemas and migrate canonical $schema references.

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Synchronize packaged schemas into the source and knowledge roots and replace former remote references.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: source
commands.description: Register and refresh authoritative repository files.

commands.name: add

options.name: --directory

options.name: --kind

options.name: --title

options.name: --revision
options.description: Immutable source revision, for example a commit sha; defaults to Git HEAD when the file is committed and clean, and is refused otherwise.

options.name: --actor

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Re-hash one source and mark every dependent observation stale when its bytes changed.

options.name: --revision

options.description: Who refreshed the bytes; recorded on the source as updatedBy. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: list

options.name: --directory

commands.name: observation
commands.description: Record atomic observed, inferred, proposed, or conflicting statements with citations, and delegate their role-aware review queue.

options.name: --directory

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Owning lcy_<UUIDv7>.

options.name: --statement

options.name: --classification
options.description: observed, inferred, proposed, or conflicted. [default: observed]

options.name: --citation

options.name: --tag
options.description: Searchable classification tag.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List observations, including stale and conflicted statements.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Optional lcy_<UUIDv7> filter.

commands.name: assignment
commands.description: Show the effective review role, routing basis, and explanation for one observation.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: delegate
commands.description: Transfer a proposed observation's accept/reject queue to another canonical role.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --from-role

options.name: --to-role

options.name: --actor

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Optional context for the receiving role.

commands.name: confirm
commands.description: Re-read a stale or unconfirmed fact against the current source and record that it still holds, keeping its id, its history, and every trace pointing at it.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Required accountable human:<name> asserting the statement survived the change.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Required: what you re-read, so the next person knows this was checked and not waved through.

commands.name: record
commands.description: Create and trace canonical needs, requirements, architecture, components, stories, changes, and test campaigns.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create one proposed typed record in a new immutable-id folder.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Owning lcy_<UUIDv7>.

options.name: --title
options.description: Concise record title.

options.name: --summary
options.description: Complete, reviewable record statement.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Affected platform metadata; repeat as needed.

options.name: --observation
options.description: Supporting obs_<UUIDv7>; repeat as needed.

options.name: --trace
options.description: Typed edge in <relation>:<target-id> form; repeat as needed.

options.name: --property
options.description: Structured detail in <name>=<value> form, for example interface=POST /payments.

options.name: --id
options.description: Component only: adopt the cmp_<UUIDv7> this repository's octoevidence.json binding declares, so binding and record share one identity.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

arguments.name: KIND
arguments.description: Record kind: need, requirement, architecture, component, story, change, test-campaign.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List canonical typed records.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Optional record-kind filter.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Optional lcy_<UUIDv7> filter.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Optional affected-platform filter; platform is record metadata, never a directory.

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Append one typed trace edge and return the record to proposed review state.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --relation
options.description: Closed trace relation.

options.name: --target
options.description: Existing target record id.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Reason for adding this trace.

commands.name: revise
commands.description: Revise one canonical record, preserve its id/history, and return it to proposed state.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --title
options.description: Optional replacement title.

options.name: --summary
options.description: Optional replacement summary.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Optional complete replacement platform list.

options.name: --observation
options.description: Optional complete replacement observation list.

options.name: --trace
options.description: Optional complete replacement trace list in <relation>:<target-id> form.

options.name: --property
options.description: Property additions/replacements in <name>=<value> form.

options.name: --remove-property
options.description: Property name to remove; repeat as needed.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Required revision rationale.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Inspect one source, observation, typed record, or generated document.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: query
commands.description: Answer a question from the fact base by reading the files, with every hit cited and carrying the edges it declares plus the edges pointing at it.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Optional lcy_<UUIDv7> filter.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Record kind; repeat as needed. Naming any kind excludes observations.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Platform; repeat as needed. Records naming no platform are shared and always match.

options.name: --status
options.description: proposed, accepted, rejected, stale, or unconfirmed; repeat as needed.

options.name: --property
options.description: Structured detail as <name> or <name>=<substring>, for example stack or interface=POST. Dotted refinements match their family.

options.name: --relation
options.description: Records carrying this trace relation.

options.name: --traces-to
options.description: Records tracing to this id.

options.name: --text
options.description: Case-insensitive substring of title, summary, property value, or observation statement.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum hits of each kind (1-500). [default: 50]

commands.name: story
commands.description: Suggest and create user stories with one planned change per platform task.

commands.name: suggest
commands.description: Read-only: for each accepted requirement without a story, the components that realise it and so the tasks a story would carry.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: lcy_<UUIDv7> project; defaults to the one project when exactly one exists.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create one proposed sto_* for a requirement and one planned chg_* per platform of each named component. The architect approves by accepting the story and advancing each task.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --requirement
options.description: req_<UUIDv7> the story satisfies.

options.name: --title
options.description: Story title, for example 'Create user profile'.

options.name: --user-story
options.description: As a … I want … so that …; defaults to the requirement's.

options.name: --component
options.description: cmp_<UUIDv7> that will carry a task; repeat as needed. One change per platform the component owns.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: questions
commands.description: Read-only: the rules this story's platforms implemented that the specification never asked for, open and settled, gathered so they are answered once.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Answer one product question the platforms already answered in code: keep every implementation that matches the decision, reject the rest, record acceptance criteria, and open the changes that follow.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --question
options.description: obs_<UUIDv7> of each open question that is the same question. Repeat as needed; omit to decide every open question on the story at once.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: obs_<UUIDv7> of every implementation that already matches the decision. Repeat as needed; omit to reject every direction.

options.name: --criterion
options.description: The answer, in your own words, added to the story's requirement as an acceptance criterion. At least one is required — it is what stops the next platform guessing at the same thing.

options.name: --amend-all
options.description: Open an amending change for every platform on the story, not only those whose direction was rejected. Use it when a platform that never raised the question does not implement the new criterion either. [default: False]

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why. Required whenever a direction is rejected.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

arguments.name: STORY
arguments.description: The sto_<UUIDv7> whose question this decision answers.

commands.name: delegate
commands.description: Hand a story's open product questions to another role. An unstated rule is sometimes a business question and sometimes an architectural one, and either role may pass it to the other.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --question
options.description: obs_<UUIDv7> to move; repeat as needed. Omit to move every open question on the story.

options.name: --from
options.description: The role handing them over.

options.name: --to
options.description: The role taking them.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why this role should decide it instead.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: change
commands.description: Open a change for a ticket key, advance it through its states, attach a ticket key to a generated task, or open a bug against it.

commands.name: open
commands.description: Open one planned chg_* pointed at the requirement it implements and the component that owns it.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --after
options.description: Change this one depends on (ticket key or chg_ id); repeat as needed. Work may start before they land; this change cannot be called implemented until they are non-rejected and deployed. Cycles are refused.

options.name: --key
options.description: Your ticket key, for example ABC-123, if you already have it. The tool never invents one.

options.name: --requirement
options.description: req_<UUIDv7> this change implements.

options.name: --component
options.description: cmp_<UUIDv7> that owns the work.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Needed only when the component owns several platforms.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: advance
commands.description: Move a change to its next state: approved (human SA) · implemented (evidence + non-rejected dependencies deployed) · deployed (deploy check) · verified (accepted evidenced verification campaign).

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look the key up in when several projects use it.

options.name: --to
options.description: approved | implemented | deployed | verified.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why, in the actor's own words.

commands.name: link
commands.description: Attach the team's ticket key to a change generated from a story.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --key
options.description: Ticket key.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: bug
commands.description: Open a bug as a new planned change in the same story, superseding the change it corrects.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look the key up in when several projects use it.

options.name: --key
options.description: Ticket key for the bug, if you have it.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

arguments.name: CHANGE
arguments.description: The chg_<UUIDv7> or ticket key the bug was found in.

commands.name: amend
commands.description: Open an amendment as a new planned change in the same story, superseding the change the product decided differently about. Not a bug: the work was not wrong.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look the key up in when several projects use it.

options.name: --key
options.description: Ticket key for the amendment, if you have it.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

arguments.name: CHANGE
arguments.description: The chg_<UUIDv7> or ticket key to supersede.

commands.name: brief
commands.description: Assemble everything an implementing agent should know for an opened change, by its ticket key or chg_ id.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Limit the search to one lcy_<UUIDv7> project.

arguments.name: KEY
arguments.description: The ticket key the change was opened with, or its chg_<UUIDv7>.

commands.name: behaviour
commands.description: Read-only: what every platform on one story states it built, side by side, with what asked for each rule and what nothing asked for.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

arguments.name: STORY
arguments.description: The sto_<UUIDv7> to compare across platforms.

commands.name: queue
commands.description: Read-only: everything waiting on one role's decision, with why each item is there and the actions open to it. The same projection the portal shows.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --role
options.description: Role id or friendly alias, for example business-analyst or ba.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: lcy_<UUIDv7> project; defaults to the one project when exactly one exists.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Accept or reject a proposed observation, typed record, or generated document as an accountable human.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --status
options.description: accepted or rejected.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Required accountable human:<name>.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Optional for acceptance; required for rejection so agents know what to revalidate.

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: obs_*, a typed lifecycle record id, or doc_*.

commands.name: review-feature
commands.description: Apply one human decision across every proposed record in a feature, in dependency order. Changes are left for individual review.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --status
options.description: accepted or rejected.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Required accountable human:<name>.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Optional for acceptance; required for rejection so agents know what to revalidate.

arguments.name: NEED
arguments.description: nde_<UUIDv7> the feature is scoped to.

commands.name: document
commands.description: Generate the feature document that reconciles one need's delivery.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Create a new proposed generated-document folder.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --feature
options.description: The nde_<UUIDv7> whose delivery the document reconciles.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Optional lcy_<UUIDv7>; must match the need's project when given.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List generated feature documents and review state.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Optional lcy_<UUIDv7> filter.

commands.name: lifecycle
commands.description: Create and inspect the project a canonical record belongs to, and reconcile it with the repository.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create one project header for a system.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --title
options.description: Human-readable system title.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Platform this system ships on; repeat for each.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human creating the project. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List every project header in the knowledge root.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Read one project header and count its records.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: reconcile
commands.description: Re-read registered source bytes after implementation and report what that unsettles.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: lcy_<UUIDv7> project to reconcile; defaults to the one project when exactly one exists.

options.name: --revision
options.description: Immutable revision to record for refreshed sources, for example a commit sha; defaults to Git HEAD when every registered source is committed and clean, and is refused otherwise.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report drift without refreshing sources or marking observations stale. [default: False]

options.name: --actor
options.description: Who ran the reconciliation; recorded on every refreshed source as updatedBy. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Run the lifecycle and agent-enablement MCP server over standard input/output.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --mode
options.description: full registers every tool; knowledge leaves out review, feature review, change advance, delegation, confirmation, and project creation, and limits reconciliation to dry runs. [default: full]

options.name: --actor-policy
options.description: any accepts human:<name> and agent:<name> actors; agent-only refuses every human:<name>, because over MCP the caller is an agent and a person decides in the portal or through the coordinator. [default: agent-only]

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Start the loopback web portal: each role sees what waits on its decision, proposes and revises knowledge, and records decisions under its own name.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --port
options.description: Loopback port to listen on (0-65535); 0 picks a free one. [default: 8765]

options.name: --open
options.description: Open the portal in the default browser once it is listening. [default: False]
